atoms.text: Amelia Earhart was born on July 24, 1897 in Atchison, Kansas. Amelia Earhart was a very impressive pilot. Her interest in aeroplanes started when she was a nurse’s aid in World War I. After that, Amelia went to university and eventually completed her pilot’s licence. This was unusual at the time because not many women had been pilots before.

atoms.text: Throughout her career, Amelia Earhart accomplished many amazing things. Earhart was the first woman, and second person ever, to fly across the Atlantic Ocean. In 1932, she flew from Newfoundland to Ireland. She was also the first person to ever fly from the United States mainland to Hawaii. She was awarded the 'Distinguished Flying Cross' award for her many flying accomplishments. In 1937, Amelia Earhart began her ambitious journey to fly around the world with her flight navigator, Fred Noonan.

atoms.text: The journey around the world began in Oakland, California and they flew east. Unfortunately, in the last part of their journey, while flying over the Pacific Ocean, Amelia Earhart and Fred Noonan disappeared. No one knows exactly what happened because the plane wreckage was never found. Some people think they crashed into the ocean, while others think they crashed onto a small island. Despite her sad ending, Amelia Earhart is still an important role model today. She accomplished many impressive things, both for women and for pilots.
